blocks.text: Unique, updated, and upgraded with every possible feature you could imagine, including a leather couch.  What's more, the hole configuration is optimized for LiveScope setups. "The Blue House" is our most luxurious and most fishable 17' Ice Castle rental.

blocks.alt: Blue Ice Castle RV Exterior For Web.jpg

blocks.text:
Our 2023 17' x 8' Ice Castle RV Edition--nicknamed The Blue House--is our most fully loaded 17' model.  It's unique layout--featuring comfortable leather jackknife couch allows for more fishing space, which sets it apart from the other houses in our lineup.  The holes patterns allow you to LiveScope 3 lines at once!  Similar to our Hybrid II, this RV edition has a noticeably higher ceiling, fireplace, large generator and a large upgraded bathroom.  This house has additional features, such as a large mechanized top bunk, and an upgraded kitchenette.


​


For those who settle for nothing less than the best, the Blue House is the house for you!
